title: Waxed Copper Indicators
description: A small honeycomb badge on waxed copper items
body:
**Waxed Copper Indicators** is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly resource pack that adds a small honeycomb badge to the corner of waxed copper items in the GUI (inventory, chests, recipes). Held and placed blocks retain their original appearance.

> **Version Note:** This pack requires **Minecraft 1.21.4 or newer** since it utilizes the new item model to dynamically overlay the badge.

This pack references the game's current honeycomb texture. If you are using a custom resource pack, the badge will automatically adapt and match that pack's style.

### With Vanilla textures
![A Minecraft inventory menu screen inside a Trial Chamber, showing a grid of various oxidized copper items and blocks. Several of the oxidized copper block icons in the menu feature a small, distinctive orange honeycomb badge in their top-right corner, indicating that they are the waxed versions of the items.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vIxsi1KE/images/b7d7dec600418345bf25f0fa4e36cf18a42c3fee.png)

### With [Faithful 64x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/faithful-64x)
![A Minecraft inventory menu screen inside a Trial Chamber using the Faithful 64x resource pack. The grid displays various high-resolution oxidized copper items and blocks. Several of the oxidized copper block icons feature a small, cleanly detailed 64x64 resolution orange honeycomb badge in their top-right corner, demonstrating how the pack scales to higher-resolution textures.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vIxsi1KE/images/5308d3a7044e96fb28bb007391ae9ba84412a119.png)

---
### How does this differ from [Waxed Indicators](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/waxed-indicators)?

I created this before I realised that a similar pack already existed. While the concept is similar, **Waxed Copper Indicators** handles compatibility better.

Instead of bundling a static, hardcoded vanilla honeycomb image inside the pack, it dynamically references whatever honeycomb texture is currently active in your game. If you use a high-resolution or stylized resource pack (like *Faithful* or *Prime HD*), the indicator badge automatically upgrades and adapts to match that pack's art style seamlessly, rather than sticking out as a low-res vanilla texture.

---
### Compatibility Feedback

I want this pack to work flawlessly with as many custom resource packs as possible. If you run into any visual bugs, or if you find a specific pack where the indicator badge looks broken or misplaced, please let me know so I can fix it.

You can report issues or suggest compatibility tweaks on [GitHub](https://github.com/AllanTaylor314/waxed-copper-indicators/issues)
